    Publish Buzz Templates with Variable Modes

    New release
    Figma Buzz
    Assets
    Design

    Templates built with Variable modes now work seamlessly when published to Buzz. This gives your marketing teams more flexibility to toggle between your brand modes like colors, campaigns, markets, and more — all while staying on brand.

    When they open a template published with variables, they’ll see a new Variable switcher in the menu to easily change modes.

    Learn more
  • Dec 10, 2025

    New ways to edit images in Design and Draw

    New release
    Update
    Figma Draw
    Design
    Dec 10, 2025

    New ways to edit images in Design and Draw

    New release
    Update
    Figma Draw
    Design

    We launched 3 new AI image editing tools, all centralized in a contextual toolbar.

    • Expand image — Extend images beyond their original borders
    • Isolate object — Select and separate an object within an image to edit, move, or resize it
    • Erase object — Select and remove unwanted objects or text from images

    Additionally, we’ve made updates to our crop tool, which include entering crop mode from two clicks, a new slider, and preserved aspect ratio.

    Learn more.

    Dec 9, 2025

    Metadata improvements for Figma Make and Sites

    New release
    Figma Make
    Figma Sites
    Websites

    Starting today, websites published from Figma Make and Figma Sites include more metadata for better search and sharing experiences. The improvements include:

    1. Auto-generated site description for Figma Make
    2. Support for OpenGraph and X tags for published Figma Make and Sites so they look better on social

    Visit our Help Center to learn more about publishing websites using Figma Make or Figma Sites.

  • Dec 9, 2025

    See your AI credit usage in Figma

    AI
    Administration
    Dec 9, 2025

    See your AI credit usage in Figma

    AI
    Administration

    Rolling out this week, admins and users can now track AI credits in Figma to understand their current usage and plan for future costs.

    Users can now view their own AI credit balance and see how many credits were used to run an AI request after that action is completed.

    Admins can now view monthly AI usage for their team or organization from the billing dashboard, including:

    • How many users are using AI credits
    • How many users have exhausted the credits included with their seat
    • Who is using AI credits, with option to filter by seat type

    To learn more about AI credits, including seat limits, credit consumption by feature, and future ways to buy more credits, check out the help center.
